notes: Brick_Doors' isDoor/isOpen, openCW/openCCW and closedCW/closedCCW fields lower to native click swaps and destination sound bindings. The engine replaces collision and occupancy when the footprint changes and plays BrickChangeSound unless the destination has noBrickSounds. Support_Doors supplies that Torque framework, which the native package does not execute or require. Its source dependency remains in the import report as evidence.

handles.server.cs: the imported door fields use native swaps, cooldown and destination sound bindings; no Torque Support_Doors package is needed at runtime
handles.dependency:Support_Doors: the imported native click swaps, changing occupancy/collision and destination sound bindings replace this Torque framework
